source.scope: store-wide (NOT product-scoped) — an order belongs to Kamsi if its the order matches Organic's rule (see below) AND contains one of Kamsi's owned product IDs, OR the order is first-session Direct whose 2nd session is NOT Google Ads paid search (i.e. "pure organic" Direct, per user request 2026-07-30) AND contains one of her products. Checked before Dilaksi, Direct and Organic, so her product-owned orders never land in any of those.. Order-level rows (no per-product breakdown) with full session history. Groups are checked in a fixed priority order (DM-Ad -> Meta -> Sonya -> Sajeepan -> Sukirtha -> Kamsi -> Dilaksi -> Direct -> Organic -> CPPC -> Thishoban -> Theekshy -> Thanishtika) so no order can appear in more than one group's tab. Standalone page, built 2026-07-27.
